title: 0/1 Knapsack Problem
description: Learn how Dynamic Programming solves optimization problems under strict capacity constraints.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content:
The 0/1 Knapsack Problem is one of the most famous optimization problems in computer science.

The objective is to maximize total value while staying within a limited carrying capacity.

Dynamic Programming solves this efficiently by systematically evaluating combinations of decisions.

sections.title: Understanding the Knapsack Problem
sections.content:
Suppose a backpack has limited weight capacity and several items are available.

Each item has both a weight and a value.

The challenge is to select the combination of items that produces the highest total value without exceeding the capacity limit.

sections.title: Why Brute Force Becomes Inefficient
sections.content:
A brute force solution would examine every possible combination of items.

As the number of items increases, the number of combinations grows exponentially.

This quickly becomes impractical for large datasets.

sections.title: Dynamic Programming Solution
sections.content:
Dynamic Programming solves the problem using a two-dimensional table.

Each table entry represents the best possible value achievable for a specific capacity and subset of items.

By reusing previously computed results, the algorithm efficiently constructs the optimal final solution.

sections.title: Include or Exclude Decisions
sections.content:
For every item, the algorithm evaluates two possibilities: include the item or exclude it.

The algorithm compares both choices and selects the better option while respecting the remaining capacity.

This repeated decision-making process gradually builds the optimal combination.

sections.title: Optimization Problems in Real Life
sections.content:
Knapsack-style optimization appears in logistics, cargo loading, budgeting, investment planning, and resource allocation.

Companies constantly optimize limited resources to maximize efficiency, profit, or performance.

sections.title: Lesson Summary
sections.content: The 0/1 Knapsack Problem demonstrates how Dynamic Programming solves constrained optimization problems efficiently by reusing intermediate results and evaluating inclusion or exclusion decisions systematically.
